states.name: S_INIT
states.description: Fresh pre-scan instance. Outputs hold declared initial values.

states.name: S_INVALID
states.description: windowSize < 1 or windowSize > 100. error=TRUE, status=16#8200. No sample accepted. History and internal mean/reached are preserved.

states.name: S_RESET_CLEAR
states.description: Valid window and reset=TRUE. History is cleared, average=0.0, windowSizeReached=FALSE. No sample accepted.

states.name: S_WARMUP
states.description: Valid window, no error, 0 < historyCount < windowSize.

states.name: S_FULL
states.description: Valid window, no error, historyCount=windowSize. windowSizeReached=TRUE.

transitions.action: Set invalid/error state. Preserve internalAverage, internalWindowSizeReached, and history. Do not accept sample.
Clear history and historySum. internalAverage:=0.0; internalWindowSizeReached:=FALSE; lastValidWindowSize:=windowSize. Do not accept sample.

transitions.to: [S_EMPTY if count=0; S_WARMUP if 0<count<windowSize; S_FULL if count=windowSize]
transitions.action: If windowChanged, clear history before any sample. If cyclicExecution OR triggerRise, accept exactly one sample and update ring buffer/sum/count. Set state from historyCount.
Keep error/status set. Preserve internalAverage, internalWindowSizeReached, and history. Do not accept sample.
Return to valid configuration, clear error/status, clear history, set average=0.0 and reached=FALSE. Update lastValidWindowSize.

transitions.to: [S_EMPTY if count=0 after optional clear; S_WARMUP if 0<count<windowSize; S_FULL if count=windowSize]
transitions.action: Clear error/status. If windowChanged, clear history before same-scan sample. Accept at most one sample if cyclicExecution OR triggerRise.
Invalid window takes priority. Set error/status and preserve current mean/history.
Continue clearing history and forcing average=0.0, reached=FALSE. No sample accepted.

transitions.to: [S_EMPTY if no accept; S_WARMUP or S_FULL if accept]
transitions.action: If cyclicExecution OR triggerRise, accept one sample; otherwise remain empty. State selected by resulting historyCount.
Clear history and force average=0.0, reached=FALSE.
If windowChanged, clear history. Accept one sample only if cyclicExecution OR triggerRise. Next state by count.
Clear history and force average=0.0, reached=FALSE.
If windowChanged, clear history first. If cyclicExecution OR triggerRise, accept one sample. Next state by count; no event holds WARMUP.
Clear history and force average=0.0, reached=FALSE.
If windowChanged, clear history first. If cyclicExecution OR triggerRise, replace oldest and keep count=windowSize. No event holds FULL.

timer_plan.implementation_note: Stage 3 remains present but contains no TON/TOF/TP calls. No timer FB is conditionally embedded inside CASE/IF.

priorities: Invalid window configuration is highest priority: windowSize outside 1..100 sets error=TRUE, status=16#8200, and does not accept a sample.
Invalid-window scans preserve average, windowSizeReached, and active history; only error/status are forced.
For a valid window, reset overrides sample acceptance: clear history, average=0.0, windowSizeReached=FALSE, and accept no sample in that scan.
For a valid window, returning from invalid clears error/status.
A valid window-size change clears history before any same-scan accepted sample.
Accept exactly one sample per scan when validWindow AND NOT reset AND (cyclicExecution OR triggerRise).
cyclicExecution and triggerRise are ORed; they must never cause double insertion.
triggerRise is computed from pre-scan previousTrigger; previousTrigger is updated unconditionally on every scan, including invalid, reset, hold, and no-event scans.
Ring-buffer access is bounded to 0..99; windowSize is validated before any indexing based on it.
Outputs are assigned once in the final unified output stage from internal state, not from multiple code paths.
scan_execution_order: Stage 1 - Edge sampling: sample all inputs once. triggerRise := trigger AND NOT previousTrigger using the retained pre-scan previousTrigger. Then update previousTrigger := trigger unconditionally for this scan, including invalid/reset/no-event scans.

Stage 2 - Safety/reset priority and state transitions: evaluate window validity first. Invalid: set invalid flag/error/status and preserve history/internal mean/windowSizeReached; accept no sample. Valid: clear error/status; if reset, clear history and force internal average=0.0 and reached=FALSE; else if valid window size changed, clear history before same-scan sampling; then accept exactly one sample only if cyclicExecution OR triggerRise. Update ring buffer, historySum, historyCount, internalAverage, and internalWindowSizeReached. Select next state.

Stage 3 - Unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF: no timer FBs are used in this FB. If a timer is added later, call it unconditionally at top level before final output assignment, never inside CASE/IF or state transition branches.

Stage 4 - Unified output assignments: average := internalAverage; windowSizeReached := internalWindowSizeReached; error := invalidWindow; status := IF invalidWindow THEN 16#8200 ELSE 16#0000. No output is written outside this stage.
